en: Vintage German-language postcard showing a Swiss-chalet style house in a wooded rural setting with a small inset of two St. Bernard dogs. Caption identifies the place as the Schweizerhaus "Krüger" (formerly Wolfzettel) near Marburg. Publisher credit appears on the left edge. The reverse is an Austro‑Hungarian Correspondenz‑Karte addressed to Fräulein Emma Richner with Marburg postmarks.
